unconfirmed: Size 156488 (IDA) and the 662704 anchor: REFUTED. BG_GetCharacterInfo@0x1417ca480 takes `struct cg_t *characterInfoBase` (pseudocode: `characterInfoBase[1].playerWeaponInfo[13720 * i + 30880]`), not BgStatic. Remove the anchor

structs.notes: BgStatic is a polymorphic base with only its vtable. Every BgStatic method reads [this] only as a vtable (virtual calls at +64/+104/+112/+128/+136), so the base has no data Replay touches. The three 'BgStatic::vector_deleting_dtor*' functions named as its deleting destructors are NOT BgStatic: they are slot 0 of CGMovingPlatforms_vftable (0x14251d9b8), CGMovingPlatformsMP_vftable (0x142523b08) and CGMovingPlatformsSP_vftable_2526660 (0x142526660), see renames. The 'sizes_passed_to_sized_delete {8: 3}' lead comes from those three moving-platform dtors (`mov edx, 8`), so it says nothing about BgStatic. CgStaticMP is not proven to derive from BgStatic at 0 (its game-test base is 16 bytes; its AttachWeapon call site was not checked here).

structs.name: BgPredictedEntitySystem
structs.size_evidence: NOT PROVEN. Lower bound 12: ResetPredictionKeys writes dword +8. Upper bound 20 by method 7 (if the derived CgPredictedEntitySystem's first own member is at +20; not proven): the CgPredictedEntitySystem object is the block CG_MainMP_AllocateClientMemory@0x14178fdf0 allocates with stride 28968 (`Mem_HunkUser_AllocInternal(...)` loop `v46 += 3621` QWORDs), stored in CG_PredictedEnt_slotPointers[jj]. The same table is read by CG_PredictedEnt_GetSlotPointer@0x1416e4b90, and that pointer is ResetPredictionKeys's `this` (CG_PlayerStateMP_ApplyFrameEffects@0x14179e7e0, CG_ViewSP_UpdateEntryVisionAndPrediction@0x1417ce1e0). The allocation loop writes 0 at +20 (`*((_DWORD*)v46+5)=0`) and at +28696 (`v46[3587]=0`), which match CgPredictedEntitySystem::CanSpawnNewEntities@0x1416e40c0 (`cmp dword [rcx+14h], 20h` = m_numEntities; `cmp qword [rcx+7018h], 0` = m_firstFreeEntity). So +20 belongs to CgPredictedEntitySystem, and the base ends at or before +20. IDA's 72 and game-test's 16 are both unproven; 72 puts m_predictionKeys (+64) inside the derived region.
members: BgPredictedEntitySystem::ResetPredictionKeys@0x140cdf300: `mov dword ptr [rcx+8], 1` (the whole function: `this->m_currentPredictionIndex = 1; return`). CAVEAT: BgCountedObject_ctor@0x140cdf250 also writes `mov dword ptr [rcx+8], 1` on the same block (refcount = 1); the name may be a misnomer for a BgCountedObject field, see notes
unconfirmed: __vftable at +0: the CG block constructor stores its own vtable there (`*v46 = &CG_MainMP_clientBlockVftable_251FBF8`), so a vtable exists at +0; no BgPredictedEntitySystem-specific access
m_predictionKeys (IDA +64, unsigned __int64): no Replay access; +64 is inside the CgPredictedEntitySystem block where the derived members are
IDA _padC (+12 .. +64): unknown; the only proven bound is that the base ends at or before +20
structs.notes: Needed to settle the size: prove the inheritance (CgPredictedEntitySystem's ctor or allocation storing a base subobject at +0 and the derived own members starting at +20) and the base's own ctor size. BgCountedObject_ctor (0x140cdf250, 21 bytes: vtable at +0, dword 1 at +8) runs on the same CG block just before the CG vtable overwrites +0; the +8 dword may be that refcount, not m_currentPredictionIndex. Game-test has only the +8 dword and size 16. The other game-test BgPredictedEntitySystem methods (SetPredictionKey, IsSamePredictionKey, GetClientNumFromPredictionKey, ...) are not in the Replay function list (no hit in the names table).
